__comment: OAuth2 replaces any username/password validator. customUI hosts the consent webview (like com.palm.eas / com.palm.skype); it loads OAuth2.buildAuthorizeUrl(), captures ?code= (plus the account's data-region hostname/locationid) from the redirect to Config.REDIRECT_URI, then calls exchangeCode which does the code->token exchange ON THE REGION HOST and returns the stored token credentials (including common.apiHost).
__comment2: com.palm.app.cloud-auth MUST be in write/readPermissions: createAccount runs under the customUI auth app's identity and is permission-checked against these lists (accounts/handlers/create.js -> Utils.hasPermission). Working templates (teams/telegram/skype) list their own auth app, not com.palm.app.accounts.
__comment3: com.palm.service.pcloud is in read+writePermissions so the service itself can readCredentials(accountId) for file ops. pCloud tokens are long-lived (no refresh, no rotation), so the service does not normally write credentials back - but the write permission is kept for symmetry and future use (accounts/handlers/credentials.js checks these lists).

capabilityProviders.__comment: No longer bound to QuickOffice (closed/dead). The file-picker app and the QuickOffice reroute consume listFolder/downloadFile/uploadFile.

Makes the pCloud account a photo source. implementation/hooks point at the stock Photos AGGREGATOR (com.palm.service.photos), which discovers PHOTO.UPLOAD accounts and (via templateId->serviceName in its Utils.js) calls com.palm.service.pcloud/listAlbums+listPhotos, then downloads bytes with the curl-patched Sync-Manager. src_big is each image's pCloud getfilelink temp URL (the curl fetch needs no auth header). pCloud has no album API, so one folder (folderid 0 = root by default) is surfaced as one album.
